evidence_items.explanation: The methods section describes human demonstrations, ranked responses and reinforcement learning. This complicates an account based solely on plausible next-word pretraining, but does not establish whether the resulting system engages with meaning or whether its errors were avoidable.

evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Adam Tauman Kalai and Santosh S. Vempala
evidence_items.explanation: The paper proves a necessity result for arbitrary facts under a calibration condition, while expressly excluding systematic facts such as arithmetic from that particular statistical argument. It neither establishes the full causal claim nor proves that launch-era ChatGPT could avoid every listed failure.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved result establishes that all the identified error families necessarily follow from ChatGPT's actual training process.
The assumptions of the hallucination theorem were not established for launch-era ChatGPT.
No agreed operational measure of the asserted absence of semantic engagement was supplied or established.
